parameters.jsCode: const results=$('Research Company').first().json?.results||[];const input=$('Validate Input').first().json;const companyContext=results.map(r=>r.title+': '+(r.content||r.snippet||'').slice(0,300)).join('\n');return[{json:{input,companyContext:companyContext||'No public company info found.'}}];

values.content: You score inbound leads for B2B sales teams. You assess fit (does this company match the ICP), intent (are there signals they're actively evaluating), and authority (is this the right person to talk to). You give a specific routing recommendation and the one or two sentences a rep should open with. Always respond in valid JSON only.
